title: Bharat Tiwari Case: JDU, BJP Assure Fair Probe, Say No Injustice Will Be Done
description: Bihar's ruling Janata Dal-United (JD-U) and the BJP on Tuesday asserted that no injustice would be done to anyone in the Bharat Tiwari encounter case and reaffirmed their commitment to ensuring a fair and transparent investigation under the state's 'sushasan' (good governance) framework.
